The newly published paper “Stability-Constrained Meta-Reinforcement Defence against Learning-Enabled Autonomous Malware” by Basavaraj Chunchure, Mantesh Patil, and Basavaraj G. Kudamble presents a novel modelling framework for detection of AI-based intrusions. The proposed model successfully undergoes cross-validation based on large benchmark datasets.
Read online: https://www.acigjournal.com/Stability-Constrained-Meta-Reinforcement-Defence-against-Learning-Enabled-Autonomous,231121,0,2.html

🌐 Applied Cybersecurity & Internet Governance (#ACIG) is published by #NASK – National Research Institute
